purpose: Complete a new fresh-panel evaluation of all fixed S1 actors after the original native evaluation was interrupted by a host reboot. Evaluation only; no new scientific mechanism or repeat fitting.
closed_fit_reuse: Copy the nine exact original checkpoint packages and the reference bytes. Preserve all policy, normalization, Adam and private RNG payloads; do not refit, reset, reserialize, strip or extend them. Adam/RNG state is preserved for ownership, never used for optimization.
historical_episode_role: All original complete and partial native attempts remain interrupted-run development context. None is pooled into the new primary or confirmation panels.

platform.physics: Unchanged native CPU task/XML, frame_skip 4; no Warp.

confirmation: Run both complete 16-reset panels for all ten actors unconditionally, regardless of source arm or primary outcome.

walking_screen.confirmed_benefit: The same walking screen passes separately on primary and confirmation.

competence.scope: Report every individual actor and all three training pairs; one competent seed is not seed-robust fitting.

bootstrap.unit: Paired training seeds crossed with shared reset contexts; descriptive only, no frame independence or population coverage claim.

reconstruction: Reuse the closed S1 fit/reconstruction evidence and its original hashes; no new reconstruction forward calls or checkpoint selection.

durability_prerequisites.closed_episode_segments: Use a new evaluation orchestrator with a separate existing-Meter HDF and ledger segment per episode. Close and fsync both files and their directory before committing that episode. Closed committed segments are immutable and never reopened for writing; one ever-growing HDF is not the authoritative durable store. Preserve the existing raw-array SHA/dtype/shape contract, with per-segment evidence-directory ownership.
durability_prerequisites.atomic_receipt: Create a per-episode JSON receipt binding source/config/input/checkpoint/reset/boot identities, complete segment file hashes, raw-array hashes, outcomes and cumulative work. Commit via a create-only atomic rename, then fsync the receipt and directory. A console line or local ledger event alone is not an externally committed episode.
durability_prerequisites.off_host_copy: Before the next episode, the existing coordinator on the local Mac pulls only the CLOSED HDF/ledger segment and receipt to an independent disk, verifies exact hashes, and acknowledges that episode. No open-HDF copy is accepted as the durable backup. Stop on a failed or missing acknowledgement within 60 seconds; charge transfer/wait time to the overall deadline and report engineering work separately.
durability_prerequisites.cumulative_budget: The new owner tracks the sum of all per-episode segment work against the single 320-episode/global work budget. Creating a new Meter segment never replenishes scientific budgets or resets the cumulative deadline.
durability_prerequisites.boot_guard: Pin the worker host boot ID in the new one-shot owner/launch record. Check it at each episode boundary and bind PID identity to boot ID. An external coordinator also records observed boot changes. A reboot, vanished owner or stale PID cannot trigger an automatic restart or append to the run.
durability_prerequisites.synthetic_acceptance: Before any new authorization, test close/fsync failure, writer death and truncated active-HDF tails, recovery of prior immutable CLOSED segments, mirror/hash failure, missing acknowledgement, boot change and duplicate create-only paths using synthetic arrays/fake controllers. Test that segment rotation does not replenish budgets. These engineering tests perform no real policy inference, fitting or native physics.

preauthorization_requirements: Independent scoped audit of the original closed fit and interrupted evaluation prefix; retain original bytes and recovery-copy provenance.
Reverify the S1 config/input/source/fit-result and ten checkpoint pins plus normalization/task/XML/actor interfaces.
Audit fresh reset ranges against then-current local/remote configuration and known reset ledgers, without replacing IDs after outcomes.
Verify the native CPU interpreter/package/source pins, host identity and implemented durability/boot guards.
Create a fresh source/input/config/platform seal and a reviewable immutable roster/budget; obtain explicit authorization for this new evaluation-only run.
cost_accounting: Keep original closed fit costs, original verified evaluation-prefix costs, original interrupted/unknown work, recovery/export engineering and new S1.1 costs as separate rows. Aggregate only known disjoint work; never replace unknown costs with zero or charge inherited fitting as newly executed. Record off-host mirror bytes and time separately from worker storage.
storage_scope: The 16 GiB cap covers the new worker run including per-episode HDF/ledger segments and receipts. Off-host mirror/storage-copy costs are separately reported, never described as zero.
stopping: One new evaluation-only attempt: ten fixed actors on both fresh16-reset panels,320episodes. No retraining/reconstruction/GPU/MPPI/retries. Stop on source/boot/owner/interface/numeric/pairing/durability/mirror/ack/work/wall/storage error; preserve completed and partial/unknown work. No automatic follow-up.
claim_scope: Fresh evaluation of the same three paired S1 training realizations, not new training replications. The original S1 remains interrupted. A confirmed whole-source effect is conditional on the existing corpora/learner and does not isolate multimodality, establish competent MPPI teaching, authorize coupling or close the loop.
authorization: User: Can you go ahead and continue with it then. Implement durability safeguards and execute the evaluation-only S1.1 protocol; no repeat fitting or automatic follow-up.

learning.minibatches: Same private PCG64 index tape within each source pair; with replacement; preserve all tapes.

normalization: Exact shared W2 normalization.npz buffers, fitted only on the 4,000 original MPPI training observations. No per-source refit or use of held observations.

policy.execution: Direct bounded torque each0.008s, native CPU, no teacher prefix or fallback.
